Facsimile. Oriented with north toward the upper right. Relief shown pictorially. Pictorial map. "Sold by Capt. John Bonner and Willm. Price against ye Town House where may be had all sorts of prints, mapps, &etc." "Engraved from a copy in the possession of Wm Taylor Esq. and published by George G. Smith, engraver, 1867." "I have examined this plan and find it to be an exact copy of the original. Stephen P. Fuller, surveyor, Boston, July 2, 1835." Reproduced from a copy of State II(1725). Includes index to points of interest and chronological lists of "Great Fires" and "Genll. small pox." Scale ca. 1:5,600. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
